apple.title: Apple requires a registered sending domain
apple.body: This address routes through Apple Private Relay or iCloud. Apple accepts mail only from domains with aligned SPF and DKIM that are registered with them.
apple.action: Authenticate your sending domain (SPF + DKIM aligned) and register it in Apple's iCloud postmaster, then resend.

googleBulk.title: Google rejected on bulk-sender authentication
googleBulk.body: Google enforces authentication for bulk senders: SPF or DKIM alignment plus a DMARC record on the sending domain.
googleBulk.action: Publish a DMARC record and confirm SPF or DKIM aligns with your From domain, then resend.

microsoftBlock.title: Microsoft SmartScreen blocked this message
microsoftBlock.body: Outlook, Hotmail, and Live filtered this send on reputation. The block clears as your sending history improves.
microsoftBlock.action: Enroll in Microsoft SNDS and JMRP, reduce complaint volume, and slow the sending pace to this domain.

noMailbox.title: No such mailbox
noMailbox.body: The recipient server reported the address does not exist. A typo causes most of these.
noMailbox.action: Confirm the exact address with the recipient before sending again.

badDomain.title: Bad destination system
badDomain.body: The recipient's mail system rejected the address as invalid.
badDomain.action: Verify the domain and address are correct, then send to the corrected address.

mailboxDisabled.title: Mailbox disabled
mailboxDisabled.body: The address exists but the mailbox is inactive or suspended.
mailboxDisabled.action: Reach the recipient another way to confirm an active address before resending.

mailboxFull.title: Mailbox full
mailboxFull.body: The recipient's mailbox is over quota. This usually clears on its own.
mailboxFull.action: Wait and resend later; the address remains valid.

messageTooLarge.title: Message too large
messageTooLarge.body: The recipient server refused the message for exceeding its size limit.
messageTooLarge.action: Shrink the message or host large attachments behind a link, then resend.

dnsRouting.title: Domain does not resolve
dnsRouting.body: The recipient domain has no reachable mail server (missing or broken DNS/MX).
dnsRouting.action: Check the domain for a typo; if it is correct, the domain cannot receive mail right now.

policyBlock.title: Blocked by recipient policy
policyBlock.body: The recipient server refused the message on a content or reputation policy.
policyBlock.action: Review the message content and your sending reputation before retrying.

authFailure.title: Authentication failed
authFailure.body: The recipient rejected the message for failing SPF, DKIM, or DMARC.
authFailure.action: Fix your domain's SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment, then resend.

greylisted.title: Greylisted or rate-limited
greylisted.body: The recipient server temporarily deferred the message and expects a retry.
greylisted.action: No action needed; delivery is retried automatically.

permanentGeneral.title: Permanent bounce
permanentGeneral.body: The recipient server permanently rejected the message. This address will keep bouncing.
permanentGeneral.action: Confirm the address is correct; the address is suppressed until you do.

noEmail.title: Address does not exist
noEmail.body: The recipient server reported no mailbox for this address.
noEmail.action: Confirm the exact address with the recipient before sending again.

suppressed.title: On the SES suppression list
suppressed.body: This address recently bounced or complained across the platform and was suppressed globally.
suppressed.action: Only resend if you have confirmed the mailbox is valid again.

onAccountSuppressionList.title: On your account suppression list
onAccountSuppressionList.body: This address is suppressed for your account from a prior bounce or complaint.
onAccountSuppressionList.action: Remove the suppression only after the mailbox is confirmed valid.

transientGeneral.title: Temporary bounce
transientGeneral.body: The recipient server deferred the message for a temporary reason.
transientGeneral.action: Delivery is retried automatically; no action needed.

mailboxFull.title: Mailbox full
mailboxFull.body: The recipient's mailbox is over quota. This usually clears on its own.
mailboxFull.action: Wait and resend later; the address remains valid.

messageTooLarge.title: Message too large
messageTooLarge.body: The recipient server refused the message for exceeding its size limit.
messageTooLarge.action: Shrink the message or host large attachments behind a link, then resend.

contentRejected.title: Content rejected
contentRejected.body: The recipient server refused the message based on its content.
contentRejected.action: Review the message body and links, then resend.

attachmentRejected.title: Attachment rejected
attachmentRejected.body: The recipient server refused the message for a blocked attachment type.
attachmentRejected.action: Remove or link to the attachment instead, then resend.

undetermined.title: Bounce reason undetermined
undetermined.body: The recipient server did not give a clear reason for the bounce.
undetermined.action: Check the SMTP response below; resend cautiously if the address is valid.

permanent.title: Permanent bounce
permanent.body: The recipient server permanently rejected the message.
permanent.action: Confirm the address is correct before sending again.

transient.title: Temporary bounce
transient.body: The recipient server deferred the message for a temporary reason.
transient.action: Delivery is retried automatically; no action needed.

undetermined.title: Bounce reason undetermined
undetermined.body: The recipient server did not give a clear reason for the bounce.
undetermined.action: Check the SMTP response below for detail.

unknown.title: Delivery failed
unknown.body: The recipient server rejected the message without a reason we can map.
unknown.action: Check the SMTP response below; confirm the address before resending.

abuse.title: Marked as spam
abuse.body: The recipient reported this message as spam. The address is suppressed to protect your reputation.
abuse.action: Do not resend; review how this recipient was added to your list.

authFailure.title: Complaint on authentication
authFailure.body: The report cites an email authentication failure (SPF, DKIM, or DMARC).
authFailure.action: Fix your domain's SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment.

fraud.title: Reported as fraud
fraud.body: The recipient reported this message as fraud or phishing.
fraud.action: Do not resend; review the message content and sending source.

notSpam.title: Marked as not spam
notSpam.body: The recipient moved this message out of spam. This is a positive signal.

virus.title: Reported as containing a virus
virus.body: The recipient reported this message as carrying malware.
virus.action: Do not resend; scan your content and attachments.

other.title: Complaint received
other.body: The recipient filed a complaint of an unspecified type. The address is suppressed.
other.action: Do not resend; review how this recipient was added to your list.
